platform.description: Rendering profile: openshift or portable (kind and other Kubernetes).

app.description: Namespace for the frontend, both backends and the migration Job. Must equal the app chart's namespaces.app.

controller.description: Namespace for the operator. Must equal the app chart's namespaces.controller.

sessions.description: Namespace for notebook Runtimes. Must equal the app chart's namespaces.sessions.

database.description: Namespace for the evaluation PostgreSQL, created only when postgresql.enabled.

podSecurity.description: Pod Security level enforced, audited and warned in every namespace this chart creates.

labels.description: Extra labels for every namespace this chart creates.

annotations.description: Extra annotations for every namespace this chart creates.

sessionsNodeSelector.description: OpenShift only: node selector for every Pod in namespaces.sessions (openshift.io/node-selector), e.g. node-role.kubernetes.io/notebooks=.

releaseName.description: The app chart's release name. Generated certificates name its Services, and the database NetworkPolicy selects its Pods by it.

enabled.description: Install and upgrade the MarimoSession CRD.
Install the MarimoSession label-identity ValidatingAdmissionPolicy and its binding.

name.description: Generated Secret in namespaces.app with DATABASE_URL and SECRET_KEY.

existingSecret.description: Your own Secret in namespaces.app with DATABASE_URL and SECRET_KEY. Nothing is generated when set.

database.description: External PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector and TLS, used when postgresql.enabled is false.

host.description: Database host name; must match its certificate.

passwordSecret.description: Existing Secret with the user's password, read with lookup to build DATABASE_URL.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret. Empty means the release namespace.

cidrs.description: CIDRs of the database endpoints, passed to the app chart's network.database.cidrs.

peers.description: NetworkPolicyPeer objects for a database inside the cluster, passed to the app chart's network.database.peers.

name.description: Generated Secret in namespaces.app, key ca.crt, with the CA that signed the database certificate.

existingSecret.description: Your own Secret in namespaces.app with key ca.crt. Nothing is generated when set.

fromSecret.description: Existing Secret to copy the CA from, for example a CloudNativePG <cluster>-ca.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret. Empty means the release namespace.

postgresql.description: Single-instance PostgreSQL with pgvector and TLS, for evaluation only.

enabled.description: Run the evaluation PostgreSQL in namespaces.database.

name.description: Name of its StatefulSet, Service and Secrets.

storageClassName.description: StorageClass of the data volume. Empty uses the cluster default.

podSecurityContext.description: Portable profile only: extra Pod securityContext fields, e.g. runAsUser 999. Refused on openshift.

caSecretName.description: Secret in the release namespace with the platform CA and its key.

caValidityDays.description: Validity of a newly generated platform CA, in days.

certValidityDays.description: Validity of newly issued leaf certificates, in days.

publicHosts.description: Portable profile: host names the Ingress serves, added to the frontend and backend-public certificates.

name.description: Secret in namespaces.sessions with the CA Runtime Pods use to verify the internal API.

serviceCABundle.description: OpenShift: PEM of the service CA. Empty reads ConfigMap openshift-config-managed/service-ca on every install and upgrade.

mode.description: nfs, or hostPath for single-node test clusters (refused on openshift).

server.description: Default NFS server for Workspace storage and every share.

mountOptions.description: Mount options for every NFS PersistentVolume, e.g. nfsvers=4.2. Read-only shares also get ro.

workspaces.description: Workspace Files: one directory per Workspace under workspaces/ at the export's root.

enabled.description: Create the Workspace PersistentVolume and claim.

path.description: Export path whose root holds workspaces/. Must not be inside, or contain, any share.

hostPath.description: hostPath mode: directory on the node. Empty means path.

capacity.description: Capacity of the PersistentVolume and claim.

mountPath.description: Where notebooks see their Workspace's directory.

shares.description: Shared data exports mounted into notebooks at the same path NFS clients use.

path.description: Export path; also the default mountPath.

hostPath.description: hostPath mode: directory on the node. Empty means path.

capacity.description: Capacity of the PersistentVolume and claim. Empty means 100Gi.

mountPath.description: Where notebooks see the share. Empty means path.

subPath.description: Existing directory inside the export to mount instead of its root.

readOnly.description: Mount read-only (default true); adds the ro mount option in nfs mode.

modes.description: Runtime modes that mount the share (default edit and run). deploy only for a read-only share.

supplementalGroups.description: Groups that own the share's files.

internalPullerNamespace.description: OpenShift internal registry: namespace whose image streams hold the MarimoHub images. The three app namespaces get system:image-puller there. Empty creates nothing.

dnsPorts.description: DNS ports the database test Pod may reach (53 and OpenShift's 5353).

image.description: Image for the storage test Pod (helm test), digest-pinned.
